context.title: Decisions with conditions
context.objective: Trace an if/else branch and distinguish strict equality from assignment.
context.body: The reviewed notes conflict: one says === compares type and value; another says === converts numeric strings before comparing. No clarification or explanatory details resolving this conflict have been supplied.

rubric: Accurate, grounded in the supplied reviewed reference and useful for a beginner; at most 180 words, plain text and readable code.
No grading, mastery claim, selected exercise answer, invented source/URL, personal-data request or claim to have seen learner reasoning.
This interface has only a selected guidance intent: do not ask the learner to paste a question, answer, code or additional reference.
Acknowledge insufficient/conflicting reviewed information and defer to available lesson text/practice feedback; do not silently select a disputed reference, fabricate examples or ask for more input.

reply.text: The reviewed lesson does not provide enough information. Continue with the available lesson text and practice feedback.

review.reviewer: Codex — AI-assisted editorial review; not independent human validation
review.notes: Full canonical uncertainty guidance acknowledges insufficient reference and directs the learner to available text/practice feedback, without choosing a disputed rule, inventing content or requesting chat input. Output includes the app canonical-uncertainty-1 text policy; this is an application response fix, not proof that provider-only wording improved.
